description: The file defines the Wearable Watch Face service, specifically a class extending CanvasWatchFaceService with an inner Engine class. It manages displaying calendar information on a Wear OS watch face, including loading calendar events asynchronously, handling permissions, and rendering a text layout with meeting counts.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService to create a custom watch face that displays calendar info.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine handling drawing, updates, permissions, and loading calendar events asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine class responsible for rendering the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, sets style, text paint, and checks calendar permission.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by removing message handlers and unregistering receivers.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, prompts for permissions if needed.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the calendar info or permission message onto the canvas.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes, registering or unregistering broadcast receivers and triggering data load.

methods.name: onMeetingsLoaded
methods.description: Updates the meeting count and redraws when calendar data is loaded.

methods.name: cancelLoadMeetingTask
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing AsyncTask for loading meetings.
